correctness.rationale: For every d>=2 and induced matching F, the anticommutation of signed flips proves H0²=dI. Each altered edge generates a 4D W_e with Gram determinant (d-1)²; pairwise W_e orthogonality follows from the induced-matching condition. The rank-two perturbations preserve their W_e and annihilate others. The explicit 4x4 characteristic polynomial yields all four energy roots per edge; the orthogonal complement retains exact ±sqrt(d) levels with stated multiplicities. Basis supports lie within 2d sites. Separate generated checker tests 108 full spectra for d=2..8 and independent strengths, 68 exact cage/rank/orthogonality cases and a symbolic Q3 boundary witness. Finite tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: Exact spectral response to many separated missing or weakened bonds in a fully frustrated finite network is a natural bond-defect and flat-band robustness question. The simultaneous dimension-independent 4D cage size, completely independent strength tunability, exact finite-size multiplicity count and explicit failure outside the geometric separation condition are structural and reusable, not a small numerical improvement or parameter substitution. The unrestricted dimension and matching size, together with an explicit configuration design criterion, give a concrete mathematical boundary for survival of magnetic localization.
